Qualcomm data center AI200 competition Nvidia custom ASIC risk 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 稱 QCT 面臨客戶內部自研產品的競爭（含最大客戶），並將客戶垂直整合列為風險因子；也與替代通訊技術競爭。
findings.excerpt: QCT also faces competition, which may intensify in the future, from products internally developed by our customers, including some of our largest customers.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子列出「客戶垂直整合（自行開發積體電路產品）可能損害半導體業務」。
findings.excerpt: Our business, particularly our semiconductor business, may suffer as a result of our customers vertically integrating (i.e., developing their own integrated circuit products).

clues.claim: Apple 自研 C1 系列數據機已用於 iPhone 16e、iPhone Air、iPad Pro，取代高通晶片；高通稱非 Apple QCT 營收成長 18%。
clues.source: MacRumors: Qualcomm Now Relies on Android as Apple Modems Roll Out

substitute_technology.note: AI200/AI250 資料中心推論晶片面對 Nvidia 與超大雲端自研 ASIC，搜尋摘要無可逐字原文，未列 finding。
